slides.h:
5 Word tricks for
when the document
is 60 pages long.

slides.b: Use Heading 1 and Heading 2 for every title, not bold text. Everything below works because of this.
References, Table of Contents. Update it before you submit. Page numbers fix themselves.
Layout, Breaks, Next Page. Roman numerals for the front pages, 1, 2, 3 from Chapter One.
Right-click a table or figure, Insert Caption. Numbers update when you move them around.
Ctrl + F opens it. Click Headings and jump to any chapter, or drag one to move it.

Tell Toso what the document is for. Get it finished in Word, headings, contents and page numbers done.
